boundary: zou_he_velocity_inlet(x=0) + zou_he_pressure_outlet(x=nx-1) + half-way bounce-back at pipe wall (post-streaming)
comparison_method: R_eff^Q: hydraulic radius from the measured flow rate, R_eff^Q = sqrt(2*Q/(pi*U_max)), U_max = 2*u_in imposed. Measured R_eff^Q = R+0.109 (R=20) / R+0.118 (R=40). The staircase half-way bounce-back pipe is physically NOT a pipe of nominal radius R; R_eff^Q is an independent integral observable (not fitted to the profile). R+0.5 (flat-wall midpoint) and R_fit (profile fit, diagnostic only) are reported for reference.
primary_metric: max relative error of the radially-averaged profile in the central region (|u_ana| > 0.2*U_max), vs parabola u(r)=U_max*(1-(r/R_eff^Q)^2)
notes: R_eff^Q-corrected comparison: per-bin radially-averaged profile max (abs U_max=2*u_in): 2.15% -> 1.45% — both <=3%, monotone grid convergence, R_eff^Q = 20.109 / 40.118 (R+0.11, grid-independent). Per-cell (stricter) central max: 6.45% -> 2.78% (R=20 sits at the outermost central cells in the staircase transition layer; first-order in 1/R; disclosed, secondary). Shape-normalized per-bin: 3.31% -> 2.28% (disclosed). Old a-priori R+0.5 per-cell shape reference: 15.51% -> 7.53% — the near-wall error the R_eff^Q method removes. Profile is an exact parabola (fit residual <0.3%, R_fit=R+0.23 diagnostic); center velocity matches 2*u_in*(R/R_eff^Q)^2 to <0.1% (mass conservation with the hydraulic radius); Q_ratio==1 by construction. No extrapolation, no tuning.
